name: self-improve
description: Self Improve: learns from a session when you mark it done, keeps soul.md (facts about you and how Claude should respond) in step with Hindsight, and tunes skills over time with your approval.

mode.title: Review mode
mode.description: off: nothing runs. suggest: everything waits in /learn for you. controlled: low-risk lessons apply themselves. advanced: skill drafts that pass validation apply themselves too.

soulBank.title: Soul Bank
soulBank.description: The Hindsight bank that holds the facts in soul.md. Operant users can set operant-soul to share one soul with Operant.

learnModel.title: Learn model
learnModel.description: The model that reads a finished session (one call per run).

rewriteModel.title: Rewrite model
rewriteModel.description: The model that drafts a rewrite of a skill that keeps getting corrected.

maxChanges.title: Max changes per run
maxChanges.description: Changes the mod may apply on its own in one run (controlled and advanced modes). 0 means no limit.

dailyUsd.title: Daily spend cap (USD)
dailyUsd.description: Estimated spend on learn calls per day. 0 means no cap.

soulCap.title: soul.md characters per session
soulCap.description: How much of soul.md each session starts with, most important first (200 to 6000).

extraSkillDirs.title: Extra skill folders
extraSkillDirs.description: More folders that hold <skill>/SKILL.md, separated by semicolons.
